messages:
Maya Chen: quick sync — Olive Branch week0 handoff: network peering timed out during test, they want final cutover next Tue. any blockers?
Tom Li: saw the timeout, looks like our peer-accept request never hit their side. I left them a note to check their NGW route table entries.
Aisha Gomez: they confirmed their firewall team blocked the egress to our peering CID. asked for allowed cidr: 10.118.0.0/16 and TCP 443.
Maya Chen: I'll send the exact bits. we should also confirm Cloud NAT rules for egress to S3 for audit logs.
Raj Patel: also need to lock down the IAM role mapping before cutover. request: assume-role from their account -> our redwood-olivesb-service-role. need policy snippet from Tom.
Tom Li: policy ready, dropping here: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["sts:AssumeRole"],"Resource":["arn:aws:iam::REPLACE:role/redwood-olivesb-service-role"]}
  ]
}
```
Maya Chen: perfect. Raj can you confirm CMK access pattern? customer wants BYOK with centralized audit.
Raj Patel: they want ciphertext decrypt only from the dedicated inference VPC. propose KMS key alias: alias/redwood/olivesb-prod. key policy to allow account cross-account decrypt for that role + our KMS admin role. we'll require key rotation monthly.
Aisha Gomez: for audit logs, they requested Splunk HEC endpoint — we need to ensure VPC endpoint to S3 and a tiny NAT gateway for Splunk forwarder. forwarding IPs: 54.210.12.55 and 54.210.12.56 (Splunk ingestion).
Maya Chen: noted. customer also flagged renewal \"risk\" early — they said latency spikes during staging. can we surface mitigation and runbook to calm them?
Tom Li: short term: enable prefix caching on their busiest routes, and pin model variant to a smaller context-length for canary traffic. mid term: schedule a Dedicated capacity trial to show consistent P99.
Raj Patel: add a security note: if they enable cross-account KMS decrypt we should have explicit CloudTrail event selector for KMS, with logs forwarded to their Splunk index and to our audit bucket for 90 days.
Maya Chen: action items summary: 1) send peering IPs/CIDR to customer (Aisha to confirm NAT paths) 2) share IAM policy and role ARN (Tom) 3) publish KMS key alias + policy draft (Raj) 4) add audit-forwarding checklist and Splunk HEC details (Tom/Aisha) 5) draft renewal health note and mitigation plan (Maya).
Aisha Gomez: I'll drop the peering snippet: ```bash
# their side should run
aws ec2 accept-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0abc1234
# and confirm route: 
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0a1b2c3d --destination-cidr-block 10.118.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0abc1234
```
Tom Li: sharing the role ARN placeholder: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-olivesb-service-role. ask them to add trust for our account id if cross-account.
Raj Patel: posting KMS policy high-level bullet points in case they want changes: - allow decrypt for role - deny crypto operations outside the dedicated subnet via condition - require kms:ViaService for our VPC endpoints.
Maya Chen: can we run a short dry-run Friday 16:00 PT? call with customer + firewall + infra folks. I'd like to include a one-page runbook and escalation matrix.
Tom Li: Friday 16:00 PT works for me. I'll prepare runbook (2 pages) and a tracing checklist for p99 regression.
Aisha Gomez: I'll bring network diag steps and the temporary firewall rule we test with (:eyes: no permanent exceptions).
Raj Patel: I'll prepare the CloudTrail/KMS selectors and a sample SIEM query for suspicious decrypt patterns.
infra-bot: audit-log: S3 delivery verified for redwood-audit-olivesb-prod at 2024-05-08T12:22:45Z — checksum OK.
Maya Chen: great — I'll email invites now and attach the runbook draft. quick ask: can we also capture their feedback on the private deploy docs? want to surface doc gaps to docs team.
Tom Li: sure — I'll add a 3-question feedback form to the runbook: 1) clarity of network steps 2) IAM/KMS guidance helpful? 3) anything missing for cutover.
Maya Chen: perfect. thanks all. I'll follow up after the Friday dry-run with an internal renewal risk update for rev ops. :thumbsup:
